h: Human Awakening Invites the Hidden Light of Shabbos

p: In the Kiddush of the day we say,
a remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt."
Yet in truth only the festivals
as is written in the holy Zohar
שַׁבָּת לָאו מִקּוֹדֶשׁ הִיא זְמִין וְכוּלֵּי
"Shabbos is not invited from holiness, etc.;
it is certainly called holy, etc.;
But in the language of the pasuk too,
which opened with the callings of holiness of the festivals,
and immediately afterward began with Shabbos,
"a Shabbos of rest, a calling of holiness":
Shabbos too a calling of holiness,
וְהוּא נֶגֶד דִּבְרֵי הַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
which runs against the words of the holy Zohar cited above.
But the matter of what it says,
and the holy Zohar states (many times):
there is revelation of His Shechinah, blessed be His Name;
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר לְמֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
as was said to Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
"And they shall make Me a Sanctuary
and I will dwell among them" (Shemos 25:8):
"For the entire congregation, all of them are holy"
מֵחֲמַת כִּי בְּתוֹכָם ה׳ (בְּמִדְבַּר טז, ג)
And revelation of His Shechinah, blessed be His Name,
and feeling of the glory of His Divinity;
called the light of supernal Chochmah.
For before the utterance "Let there be light"
וְאָז יָשֶׁת חוֹשֶׁךְ סִתְרוֹ (תְּהִלִּים יח, יב)
and then "He made darkness His concealment" (Tehillim 18:12);
and from the beginning of the utterance "Let there be light"
"'Wrapping Himself in light as a garment' (Tehillim 104:2):
מְלַמֵּד שֶׁנִּתְעַטֵּף הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּאוֹרָה
this teaches that the Holy One, blessed is He, wrapped Himself in light
to the Essence of the Ein Sof,
which is why "And He said" is stated of it,
meaning that there is already apprehension of revelation
is the utterance "Let there be light."
that the wicked were not worthy
He hid it away for the tzaddikim in the future
And it is stated in Sefer HaBahir:
"He took the seventh and placed it in its stead"
something of this light is revealed
And so the Midrash states (Bereishis Rabbah 11:2):
"Once the sun set on Shabbos eve,
the light began to serve, etc.";
that He blessed it with light
מַשְׁמָע דְּכֵן הוּא לְדוֹרוֹת גַּם כֵּן
implying that so it is for all generations as well.
And this is why Shabbos is called holiness itself.
And this is what we say,
the breaking forth of the light of Chochmah
And this is "and He sanctified it" of Shabbos,
and it is the good gift
"For I am Hashem Who sanctifies you"
of that light of the first day.
And this is the feeling of holiness,
for on Shabbos the Holy One, blessed is He,
bestows upon Yisrael the light of holiness
But although the essential holiness of Shabbos
is the holiness that is fixed and established
the revelation of the hidden light, as mentioned above,
that a person must sanctify it
with Kiddush of the day, with the mouth,
which is a positive mitzvah of the Torah;
and so it is stated (in Midrash Rabbah, Eikev, Devarim Rabbah 3:1):
everything to be through human choice
and through the arousal from below.
Shabbos too is called a calling of holiness.
And the essential calling of holiness of the festivals
And the essential holiness of the festivals
is also from the side of Yisrael:
Pesach, that they went out of Egypt;
Shavuos, that they received the Torah;
Rosh Hashanah, that they are judged;
Yom Kippur, that sins were atoned;
Sukkos, "For in sukkos I settled, etc.";
and it is also called the Festival of Ingathering,
at the gathering of the harvest then,
and therefore it is called the time of our rejoicing.
Therefore the fixing of the time
that they are invited from supernal holiness,
because they too are called holy.
כִּי עַם קָדוֹשׁ וְגוֹ׳ (דְּבָרִים ז, ו)
is because the Shechinah rests among them,
for this is what is called holy.
comes through the holiness of Shabbos
"I am Hashem Who sanctifies you," as above.
And this is what we say:
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הֵם מְקַדְּשׁוּ לִזְמַנִּים
and through this they sanctify the times;
and as they said (in Shemos Rabbah, end of chapter 15, 15:24),
learning from a vessel of the profane
into which something holy is put,
is "sanctify yourself in what is permitted"
even out of a weekday something holy.
when He began the section of the festivals,
And in the Zohar they are called
and they are bound to it and crowned with it,
and they are invitees and guests.
and then there is holiness in it
and a feeling of the light,
and also the inheritance of holiness,
meaning that it has no interruption;
דְּעַל כֵּן אָמַר כָּאן עַל שַׁבָּת
which is why it says here of Shabbos
And it opened with "work shall be done";
implies that it is done of itself,
and this is (as we said above in maamar 4)
the deed is completed of itself
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב רכב, ב)
for according to a person's preparation on his part
so does he receive the holiness of Shabbos;
and from the holiness of Shabbos
flows the holiness of the festivals,
And therefore the sanctification of the month was given over
to the Great Beis Din of Yisrael,
who are those who toil in Torah,
and for them even the weekdays are like Shabbos,
for they are occupied only in preparing holiness;
and for them it is a Shabbos of rest,
And here Shabbos is called a calling of holiness,
the Holy One, blessed is He, made
wishing it to be called by their name,
they can also sanctify the festivals.
And therefore we say in Kiddush of the day
the phrase "first of the callings of holiness":
all the callings of holiness come about;
and therefore in the pasuk about the festivals too
"A remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt":
that with the holiness of Shabbos
that a person invite the holiness
the revelation of the light of the first day,
which is why it is called holy,
And this light that was hidden
how is it possible for a person
to invite it and draw it down?
About this they said in Kiddush of the day
to mention the Exodus from Egypt:
for then too they drew down
"And their cry rose up to God
which is the very opposite of that light;
like the point of a needle.

paragraphs.text: Source: Devarim 7:6 — “כי עם קדוש אתה ליהוה אלהיך בך בחר  יהוה אלהיך להיות לו לעם סגלה מכל העמים אשר על פני האדמה” — “For you are a people consecrated to the ETERNAL your God: of all the peoples on earth, the ETERNAL your God chose you to be the treasured one.bthe treasured one Lit. “for Him a people of treasure.””

paragraphs.text: Source: Vayikra 23:3 — “ששת ימים תעשה מלאכה וביום השביעי שבת שבתון מקרא קדש כל מלאכה לא תעשו שבת הוא ליהוה בכל מושבתיכם” — “On six days work may be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a sabbath of complete rest, a sacred occasion. You shall do no work; it shall be a sabbath of יהוה throughout your settlements.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos 35:2 — “ששת ימים תעשה מלאכה וביום השביעי יהיה לכם קדש שבת שבתון ליהוה כל העשה בו מלאכה יומת” — “On six days work may be done, but on the seventh day you shall have a sabbath of complete rest, holy to יהוה; whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.”

The proof is that here, with regard to Passover, …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos 2:23 — “ויהי בימים הרבים ההם וימת מלך מצרים ויאנחו בני ישראל מן העבדה ויזעקו ותעל שועתם אל האלהים מן העבדה” — “A long time after that, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites were groaning under the bondage and cried out; and their cry for help from the bondage rose up to God.”
